cases.observed_problem: The legacy selector can issue a recommendation without any bookmaker quote, de-vig result, or provider availability evidence.
cases.future_required_property: A selectable market decision must cross the reviewed provider/pricing eligibility boundary before recommendation authority exists.

cases.observed_problem: Changing quote-like/provider-like attributes on the Prediction object does not participate in MarketSelector.select; current output is driven only by legacy prediction fields.
cases.future_required_property: Provider pricing evidence must be consumed by a separate reviewed pricing/routing boundary and legacy heuristic output must not masquerade as provider-value authority.

cases.observed_problem: The legacy selector has no provider-unavailable/unpriced disposition and still recommends Under 2.5 from heuristic fields alone.
cases.future_required_property: Absence of exact provider price/availability must remain an explicit non-selectable disposition rather than an actionable recommendation.

cases.observed_problem: The legacy selector can rank the ad-hoc Home or Over 1.5 label, which is not one of the reviewed current canonical MarketId identities.
cases.future_required_property: Decision authority must use exact registered canonical market/outcome identity rather than ad-hoc display labels.

cases.observed_problem: Equal-score markets retain legacy candidate construction order because the selector sorts only by score.
cases.future_required_property: Any future canonical router tie must be resolved by an explicit reviewed canonical ranking identity, not incidental candidate append order.
